lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured 2D grid of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters organized into vertical columns and horizontal rows across the visible mid-flank posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like anchor node pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible running horizontally across the upper-mid flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity highlights on the dorsal edge and shadows on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance blobs localized within the remaining basal fragment of the truncated first dorsal fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe traumatic amputation of the first dorsal fin, resulting in a jagged, depigmented white posterior margin; minor white scarring or lesions are visible on the distal edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The unique, irregular morphology of the truncated dorsal fin serves as a primary distinctive identifier.
